```yaml
name: Lint and Roadmap Validation

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, master ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, master ]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'
          cache: 'pip'

      - name: Install linting dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install flake8 black isort mypy

      - name: Check formatting with Black
        run: |
          black --check --diff .

      - name: Check import sorting with isort
        run: |
          isort --check-only --diff .

      - name: Lint with flake8
        run: |
          flake8 . --count --select=E9,F63,F7,F82 --show-source --statistics
          flake8 . --count --exit-zero --max-complexity=10 --max-line-length=127 --statistics

      - name: Type check with mypy
        run: |
          mypy . --ignore-missing-imports --no-strict-optional

  validate-roadmap:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: lint
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Validate Roadmap Structure
        run: |
          # Ensure docs/roadmap.md exists
          if [ ! -f "docs/roadmap.md" ]; then
            echo "::error::docs/roadmap.md is missing"
            exit 1
          fi

          # Check for required new sections mentioned in the request
          # Note: This is a basic validation to ensure the PR includes the requested expansions
          REQUIRED_SECTIONS=(
            "Document Understanding Tasks"
            "Data Augmentation"
            "Modeling additions"
            "Benchmarking additions"
            "Developer Experience"
          )

          MISSING_SECTIONS=()
          for section in "${REQUIRED_SECTIONS[@]}"; do
            if ! grep -q "$section" docs/roadmap.md; then
              MISSING_SECTIONS+=("$section")
            fi
          done

          if [ ${#MISSING_SECTIONS[@]} -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "::warning::The following sections are missing or not clearly defined in docs/roadmap.md: ${MISSING_SECTIONS[*]}"
            # We do not fail the build here, as this is a documentation update request, 
            # but we warn if the specific keywords aren't found.
          else
            echo "Roadmap structure validation passed."
          fi

      - name: Check for Priority Order
        run: |
          if ! grep -qi "priority" docs/roadmap.md; then
            echo "::warning::Suggested priority order not found in docs/roadmap.md"
          fi
```
